prompt: Create a refined hand-drawn portrait illustration of a handsome South Asian man in his late 20s with thick wavy black hair, strong brows, almond eyes, a straight nose, full lips, and a neatly trimmed dark beard. Show him from the chest up in a thoughtful three-quarter pose, head turned slightly to the viewer’s right, eyes looking off to the side, with his right index finger resting lightly against his lips and chin. Dress him in a soft pastel pink traditional kurta with a matching draped shawl, including delicate embroidered floral borders on the shawl, subtle fabric folds, small front buttons, and a high band collar. Use a realistic pencil-and-charcoal portrait style with fine graphite linework, visible crosshatching, soft gray facial shading, and selective muted watercolor coloring only on the clothing. Keep the skin and hair mostly monochrome graphite, with detailed texture in the hair and beard. Background should be a plain warm off-white paper texture, softly lit with no props, no text, no watermark, and no extra figures. The mood should be calm, elegant, introspective, and romantic, like a high-quality fashion portrait sketch.

promptZh: 创作一幅精致的手绘肖像插画，主角为 一位 20 多岁、英俊的南亚男性，拥有浓密的黑色波浪卷发、浓眉、杏眼、挺拔的鼻梁、丰满的嘴唇以及修剪整齐的深色胡须。采用胸部以上的构图，呈现沉思的三分之二侧面姿势，头部微微转向观众右侧，目光看向一旁，右手食指轻抵唇部和下巴。为他穿上 一件柔和的淡粉色传统库尔塔（Kurta），搭配同色系的披肩，披肩上带有精致的刺绣花边，呈现细腻的布料褶皱、小巧的前襟纽扣以及高领设计。采用逼真的铅笔炭笔肖像风格，结合细腻的石墨线条、可见的交叉排线、柔和的灰色面部阴影，并仅在衣物上点缀柔和的水彩色彩。皮肤和头发部分保持石墨单色，并呈现出头发和胡须的细腻质感。背景为 纯净的暖米白色纸张纹理，光线柔和，无道具、无文字、无水印，且画面中无其他人物。整体氛围宁静、优雅、内敛且浪漫，呈现出高质量时尚肖像素描的质感。
